item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"architecture_interaction","rationale":"Replace each residual block's first GELU branch with a GLU computing a*sigmoid(b), allowing content-dependent filtering across all four category models. Preserve causal dilations, residual paths, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so its architecture matches the trained checkpoint automatically.","edits":[{"find":"        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, hidden_units, kernel_size,\n                               dilation=dilation, padding=0)","replace":"        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, 2 * hidden_units, kernel_size,\n                               dilation=dilation, padding=0)"},{"find":"        self.activation = nn.GELU()","replace":"        self.activation = nn.GLU(dim=-1)"}]}],"change_summary":"Use gated first causal convolutions in every NextItNet residual block, retaining one independently trained model per category and matching predictor architecture."}
